message.content: "請問您能提供我有關NBA的以下資訊嗎：單場比賽中單一球員得分最高紀錄，包括球員姓名、得分數和比賽日期；單季中單一球員得分最高紀錄，包括球員姓名、得分數和賽季；以及球員生涯中得分最高紀錄，包括球員姓名、總得分數和生涯跨度？"

function.name: sports_data_basketball_most_points_single_game
function.description: Returns the record for the most points scored by a single player in one game of NBA, including the player name, points scored, and game date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

league.description: The specific basketball league for which to fetch the record. In this case, 'NBA'.

function.name: sports_data_basketball_most_points_career
